notes: Tuition: €15,000 is a single institution-wide first-year amount for Bachelor's and Single-Cycle Master's degrees in Law, quoted on both the programme page (for this programme) and the non-EU admission page; no programme-group tie was found (Luiss uses a single fee with no income brackets). Application: the application channel for this course is the university's own dedicated platform (not Universitaly); the €150 participation fee applies. Intake: only the FIRST certification selection session (Oct 2026–10 Feb 2027) is used; registration by 4 May 2027 is the enrolment deadline for admitted candidates of that session, not the application deadline, and the page states more sessions may exist. The deadline date 2024-11-25 appearing in the qualification list is an old/undated figure and was not used. No Morocco-specific country-group fee list was found on the supplied pages.

note.en: Provide a recognised certification among: SAT (total score min. 1200/1600), LSAT (min. 160/180), ACT (min. 25/36) or IB Diploma/Predicted Grade (36/45). Check the admission notice.
